taskDescription: Arrange the steps of the Grattage test (Brocq's method) in the correct order from start to finish.
paragraphs: Select a mature, untreated plaque on an accessible extensor site and obtain the patient's informed consent.
Hold a glass slide or wooden spatula at a shallow angle and gently scrape the surface — observe silvery scale flaking off like candle wax (candle-grease sign).
Continue gentle scraping until all loose scale is removed, revealing a smooth, moist, glistening film — the last membrane (Büchner sign).
Scrape the glistening membrane with minimal additional pressure — observe discrete pinpoint bleeding spots (Auspitz sign).
Stop scraping immediately once Auspitz bleeding is seen and record all three sequential endpoints as positive.
